# Warranty (Brightwater Cycles, made-up sample data)

## Frame warranty
Every frame has a 5 year warranty against manufacturing defects. Crash damage and rust caused by
poor storage are not covered.

## Battery warranty
E-bike batteries have a 2 year warranty or 500 charge cycles, whichever comes first. A battery that
holds less than 70 percent of its original capacity inside the warranty is replaced for free.
